programme.title: In-Fisherman TV
programme.desc: It's what the In-Fisherman staff does best, getting down to details that make a difference, blending field research and the best science available, to crush giant channel catfish in current; fine tune deadly grinder-style finesse swimbaits for smallmouths; and give big largemouths the old one-two with tube riggings for the ages.

programme.title: In-Fisherman TV
programme.desc: It’s what the In-Fisherman staff does best, getting down to details that make a difference, blending field research and the best science available, as they fish topwaters for river smallmouth bass, and go on the stalk for cold-water largemouths. Finally, we take you “down a historic road of discovery,” to reveal the development of the conservation concept called selective harvest.

programme.title: North American Whitetail
programme.sub-title: The Sheltons Go Back for Canadian Whitetail
programme.desc: Today, North American Whitetail Associate Haynes and his father return to Saskatchewan in search of another Canadian whitetail. In our On Target segment, Blake Garlock takes a look at quality optics for low-light encounters. We will also hear from Dr. James Kroll about whitetail sanctuaries. Our Editor-in-Chief, Haynes Shelton, hosts a Big Buck Profile of the Matt Beard Buck.

programme.title: North American Whitetail
programme.sub-title: Show Me Some Whitetail in Missouri
programme.desc: On this episode of North American Whitetail, Dale Evans makes a late-season return to the Show Me State. During our From the Stand segment Blake Garlock explains how to use deer scent as cover. In Dr. Deer, Dr. James Kroll teaches about the difference in bedding areas during summer and winter. Finally, we close with a Big Buck Profile with Haynes Shelton looking at the Corey Welford buck.
